slides.title: Save the date wording
slides.subtitle: What to write so guests don't have to ask

slides.title: Names first
slides.body: Lead with both names, then the date. Guests scan the top line and decide whether to keep reading.

slides.title: City, not the venue
slides.body: A save the date only needs the city. Venue, time and dress code belong on the invitation.

slides.title: Say what comes next
slides.body: Close with one line such as "Formal invitation to follow", so nobody books travel too early.

slides.title: Already designed for you
slides.body: Animated save the dates you edit in free Canva. Just change the names.
